title: A Near-Miss at Dying Glenrock Mall, Locking Down WHOIS, & Forming Our Virginia LLC
description: When a chilling near-miss inside the half-vacant single-story concourse of Glenrock Mall reveals that their estranged mother Brenda is trying to track them through their transit blog, Katie and Nate team up with Dad and a Virginia Beach attorney to form their own 50–50 LLC, rent a commercial virtual mailbox, and scrub every trace of personal identifying data from their domain WHOIS records.
